When it comes to Anti-wrinkle injections, the skill, experience and artistic ability of the practitioner makes a huge difference on the outcome. We use THE STRONGEST licensed product on the market, for the longest lasting results.

Here at The Gorgeous Clinic, we're  Anti-Wrinkle experts. we analyse your facial muscles, rather than simply following a template. 

This way, we can treat the exact areas needed to produce the most flawless result. This is how we've built such a fantastic reputation in this field as a clinic.

**We must carry out a free, face-to-face consultation before booking in your first treatment**

This image shows more work done at The Gorgeous Clinic.

Our gorgeous client had suffered nerve damage years earlier and felt the asymmetry in her smile was effecting her confidence on a daily basis. 

Using expertly placed B'tox, with millimeter precision to hit the correct muscles, we restored the smile she once had. 

Products such as B'tox and dermal fillers are just tools. They need to be in the hands of an experienced medically trained artist to really create a masterpiece.
